venue: Port of LA boat course (outside San Pedro breakwater)
source: derived from 44 SailSync GPS tracks (session 2796): mark positions = median of clean roundings, start line = fleet at the official gun. Replace with official course data when available.
contains: coordinates only - no routes, sides, times or results

mark1.role: windward mark 1 (end of the first beat)

mark2.method: leading quarter of second-beat tops (tracker gaps at the mark)
mark2.role: windward mark 2 (top of the second, shorter beat from the gate)

gate3.role: leeward mark (bottom of the first run)

finish.role: finish area (where boats stop racing; approximate)

races.legs_seen: beat 1 (~13 min) -> run (~9) -> beat 2 to mark 2 (~5) -> run (~6) -> beat 3 to finish (~4)
races.note: start line = 2 buoys (committee boat + pin; which is which is unknown). 'uncertain' = fewer than 5 boats rounded cleanly (tracker gaps).
